premises.text: Passengers share private pilots' flight costs through a booking marketplace
premises.evidence_span: connecting private pilots with passengers so they can share the cost of a flight

premises.text: Platform provides end-to-end booking ops including payments, matching, vetting, and insurance
premises.evidence_span: Online payments, pricing algorithm, smart matching, flight suggestion, pilot vetting, and insurance

premises.text: Passengers can request unposted flights that are routed to pilots in the region
premises.evidence_span: it's smartly sent to pilots in your region

premises.text: 2016 rules allow private pilots to share costs and advertise flights ahead of time
premises.evidence_span: they're allowed to share the cost of a flight and also advertise it on light beforehand

premises.text: Custom insurance gives customers an extra €1 million of coverage
premises.evidence_span: an extra 1 million euro coverage on all the flights you do

premises.text: Example shared pricing turns a €400 pilot cost into €100 per person with a platform commission
premises.evidence_span: This would cost him 400 euros. And thanks to Wingly, it's actually now only 100 euros per person. Wingly then takes a commission on this transaction of 15% plus 4 euros

value.text: Make private aviation accessible with convenience and pleasure via shared-cost flights
value.evidence_span: Wingly makes private aviation accessible to everybody

secondary_value.text: Environmental benefit alongside pilot and passenger gains
secondary_value.evidence_span: win-to-win for our pilots, our passengers, and also the environment
